messages.content: What is the roster of Manchester United?

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.
